notes.title: BIG Multiplayer-Update (Part 1)!
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/9ffa9573b85f44f964585f216a334a393b1eed33.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/13b77d4dd3c09ab2a8053c86d47ee6437bb71b6f.png[/img][/url]

Hello dear spirits 👻,
the big multiplayer update is finally here! After a few more delays, you can now experience unforgettable rounds together with your friends! This is all new in the update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/07d4e7ce95b6a4cae2b2780cf1ead8bba39cef7f.png[/img]

[b]Multiplayer rounds and parties[/b]

Create or join parties to play various The Land of Magic game modes together in multiplayer! When creating the party, you can make any settings you like, such as the visibility from public to private. Private parties can be joined using special room codes. All public parties are listed accordingly, allowing any player to join any party. If all this takes too long, you can also play quickmatches by immediately searching for other random players to quickly start a random round! Play up to four different game modes with your friends: High Out, Time Worlds, Star Marathon and Secret Obstacles! More game modes coming in Multiplayer Update Part 2!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/6a77a0714a6111c6b8b21a63694e8b34709c05e4.png[/img]

[b]New season and events[/b]

The second season has begun and new rewards can be earned accordingly. Complete tasks, master worlds or play multiplayer rounds! Buy the Season Star to get more special benefits.
A new event is also being added: for every multiplayer round you play, you will receive secret rewards until April 1st!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/ddfc96273380c85aa6c7d1635940ae77d1d2bfba.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/fb888fc777489f136285b4828e58c30d82379b36.png[/img][/url]

[b]Further improvements and bug fixes[/b]

Many other improvements have been made such as:
1. atmospheric music in some worlds. You can control whether this function should be on or off with a toggle.
2. outlines for players and monsters when they are hidden by objects.
3. improved and reworked filters and effects for each scene
4. smarter monsters: any monster with an extra attack, such as: jump or teleport, will be done immediately when the monster is blocked.
5. if you are represented in leaderboards, this is now also synchronized via Steam.
6. more and new, as well as extended graphics settings have now been added.

Various bug fixes:
1. not resetting the daily challenge processes and the relay hunt has been fixed.
2. the missing equipping of hats has been fixed.
3. the button animations have been adjusted so that they are no longer grayed out if you have already pressed them once.
4. the display of various windows in the menu has now been adjusted at the beginning so that windows that are no longer relevant or active should no longer open. The probability has also been reduced.

Further bug fixes have been made and implemented. For further sightings, please contact our support - Thank you! 
You can also watch the following video:
[previewyoutube=rdcaigQv2A4;full][/previewyoutube]
We also ask for your feedback so that we can make The Land of Magic as good as possible!

 - Your The Land of Magic team!

notes.title: The Christmas update!
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/5ab5b4b205cdbe8209af6718aadfcfd6c0641848.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/72abcbd9cb77255792163095e93c581a0c7b5057.png[/img][/url]

[b]The Christmas update[/b]

Dear Spirits,
in this update we have made many different adjustments and bug fixes. This is the update list, we hope you enjoy it!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/3dbbc44d4b7e66c7e72df491443479dcbdd1474d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/ad141a6e7199403d755ece43aa5c4cfda2dd20a6.png[/img][/url]

[b]Christmas![/b]

Experience the most magical time of the year in The Land of Magic with Christmas decorations and Christmas music! As always, we have adapted the game to the season!

[b]Christmas Event[/b]

There is also a special event at the end of the year. Master the Christmas world to unlock mysterious rewards. A maximum of 50 mysterious rewards can be collected!

[b]Steam Cloud[/b]

The Land of Magic now supports Steam Cloud! All your game saves are now synchronized with your Steam profile and loaded from other devices.

[b]Upcoming update[/b]

We actually have a new feature planned for the Christmas update: Multiplayer! However, this feature will now be postponed to the beginning of next year. That's why this update came a little later than usual. We ask for your understanding!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/3b539479ce458e435ed9a201f8eceb28154da3c4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/eb074174ff422fd26872cef42d164e852ef089fa.png[/img][/url]

We wish you a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year! We hope to see you in the game again next year for the big multiplayer update! Take care!

Your MagicAme-Team!

notes.title: Halloween-Events
notes.notes:
Hello dear ghosts,
In the spookiest time of the year, there are also two Halloween events in The Land of Magic! The events are limited in time and run until November 3rd. You can also see various Halloween decorations in the menu!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/edb4005d52c4c79f8752ac56955b648cc4a9dd86.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/8ed7f9ec84095e2aa0994180919699972dc3291c.png[/img][/url]

[b]The Graveyard Event[/b]
Master 8 different worlds to get a cool reward at the end. Progress is saved and will be reloaded when new such events occur. Once the eight worlds have been completed, a new start is always possible! The choice of which worlds to play is random, but everything is on the “Difficult” difficulty level, except for the last world with “Hardcore”.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/ddf0a8ac9d0fe2d6f11c9133a2b85dcfce6bdbe9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/d0a76401f54c63f84ab3174779ea5a0eab10ddbe.png[/img][/url]

[b]The special Halloween event[/b]
From October 12th to November 3rd, a new special event will take place in which you have to master as many worlds as possible to unlock cool, unknown rewards. Up to 20 of these unknown rewards can be unlocked! The process is not saved for further such events!

We wish you a Happy Halloween 🎃👻.

-Your MagicAme team!

notes.title: First season 2.0
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/ddfc96273380c85aa6c7d1635940ae77d1d2bfba.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/fb888fc777489f136285b4828e58c30d82379b36.png[/img][/url]

Hello ghosts.
a new season has begun with the old theme: Mine! We apologize for a small season update, but our capacities are currently on other projects, so The Land of Magic only gets a small update this time!

This is new in the update:
1. a new season: “First Season 2.0”! Complete tasks and earn experience to unlock fantastic rewards!
2. two new achievements: two new achievements have been added throughout the update! Complete their tasks to get cool rewards at the end!
3. more bug fixes and improvements:
We've made more improvements and bug fixes that aren't really noticeable! The most famous bug has now been fixed: the monsters no longer rotate so quickly and jerkily when the player jumps over them!

Thank you for playing The Land of Magic! If you have any questions, suggestions or requests, please let the developers know via the ingame settings and support. We look forward to hearing from you and your ideas!
Have a wonderful day ❤️🌞

-Your MagicAme team!

notes.title: New 1.1 Update - Leaderboards!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/fc25a543578e5b3056d1d9936d0c8260f6417a66.png[/img]

[b]The improved First World[/b]
In the First World, the guides have been made clearer and simpler. Now every monster is explained and you now have enough time to read and understand everything in peace. The world has been shortened in general. Now the First World is no longer the longest.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/ddfc96273380c85aa6c7d1635940ae77d1d2bfba.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/fb888fc777489f136285b4828e58c30d82379b36.png[/img][/url]

[b]Leaderboards for all game modes[/b]
Leaderboards are now finally available for all game modes! In Worlds mode, your entire mastered worlds are displayed, in High Out your high score in the current league and the high scores for all daily challenges. The high score for the current season is also displayed. You can view all leaderboards in your profile under leaderboards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/f89e744a7b0aa9363dccc57434dad613cb954033.png[/img]

[b]New news and announcements[/b]
For all those who have purchased The Land of Magic, you will receive a free gift in the News section under Messages, worth the value of the game. You can claim this once. We thank everyone who bought the game on Steam. NOW it is available for FREE and we are looking forward to more players and interest! After a long break from the game, you will also get one-time rewards, as a restart so to speak.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/9ffa9573b85f44f964585f216a334a393b1eed33.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/13b77d4dd3c09ab2a8053c86d47ee6437bb71b6f.png[/img][/url]

[b]Further bug fixes and improvements[/b]
Further bug fixes have been made:
 - You now have to play through the First World at the beginning to get to the menu, even if you quit and restart the game in the meantime.
 - Offers windows are now displayed less frequently and only when no tutorial window or event window is active and you have at least a level of 3 - 4.
 - The snail will now warn you one second in advance where it will be teleported with an effect.
 - The bug of not resetting to the last checkpoint on red platforms has been fixed.
 - Fixed the ad blocker display.
 - New controls have been added to the settings.
 - The layout of the profile has been revised.
 - New variations in the First and Second World are available.
 - Timer fixes for the graveyard event have been fixed.

If you have any further error messages or problems, please contact our support team. They will help you immediately during working days. Thank you very much!

-Your MagicAme team!

notes.title: The Land of Magic becomes Free2Play!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/b4a4e4ef86f74eeb018b83b83f4ec01a53f32fc4.png[/img]

Dear Ghosts,

we have great news for you! The Land of Magic will be available for free for everyone on Steam. We want the game to be playable by as many people as possible, so we've decided to make it free! With this change we hope to get more players and feedback. We would also welcome general discussions and further ideas. Of course, with this decision, a few questions remain unanswered, such as:

[b]When will the change happen?[/b]
The Land of Magic will be released for free on Steam in 10 days, on July 15, 2024 to be exact. It will be released differently depending on the time zone. We ask for your patience and understanding!

[b]Why was the decision made?[/b]
The decision was made by us after some time. We want to offer The Land of Magic to as many people as possible and provide a fun distraction. We also want players to give us feedback and share their own or future ideas and wishes for the game. We also hope that the number of players will increase and let us know that people are interested and want to play and improve the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/f89e744a7b0aa9363dccc57434dad613cb954033.png[/img]

[b]What happens to players who have already purchased the game?[/b]
For players who have already purchased the game, a free gift will be sent to them in the news section. This gift includes the value of the game that it previously cost. We thank all players who have previously purchased the game on Steam and look forward to a new era!

We thank all previous players and look forward to new players with more ideas and feedback. If you have any further questions or issues, check out our website: [url=https://magicame.netlify.app/news]magicame.app/news[/url] or contact our support: [url=mailto:magicamecil@gmail.com]magicamecil@gmail.com[/url].

Thank you very much!

-Your MagicAme team!

notes.title: Bug fixes and improvements
notes.notes:
We have made several bug fixes and improvements to make the game experience safer and bug free.

The following fixes and improvements have been made:
1. wrong font replaced to the correct one: a title text had a wrong font in the UI to select a random world.
2. secure currency system: We have implemented new security measures against currency hacking. Unfortunately, these changes have resulted in a reset of all existing currencies.
3. new level achieved UI has been added: Previously, when you reached a new level, you were not notified that a new level had been reached. Now a UI will tell you when you reach a new level.
4. instructions and keyboard guides have been edited: In the guide in the first world, the text has been edited to make the guide as easy to understand as possible. In addition, the key assignment for sneaking has been added to the keyboard guides.
5. fixed graphical errors: In the second world, there was an obstacle that flickered. This graphical bug has now been fixed.
6. purchase options have been added to the Season Shop: Clicking on a plus will display purchase options, for further acquisition of points. Two offers are currently available, which can also be accessed normally in the store.
7. general improvements in the UI: We have made many different UI improvements in various scenes.
8. further bug fixes: Many small, other bugs have been reworked.

If you have any further bugs, please contact our support.
Thank you very much!

notes.title: Welcome "The Land of Magic" on Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/ff609d2de8054426f44685887042d3785adeca08.png[/img]
[b]Discount promotion for the first week[/b]
The Land of Magic is now available on Steam after a long time in development and beta testing. We would like to thank all beta testers for their support and help. For the first week, The Land of Magic is offering a discount of up to 40% as a thank you to all early players. The promotion will last for 7 days after release on Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/cae32251970101b2fa31c7c861ebb0badece1f70.png[/img]
[b]Play the first season[/b]
A new world has been added to The Land of Magic: the Mine World. Explore a cave in the depths of the earth and defeat the monsters at your monster party. Play the new relay chase mode in the mine as well by overcoming obstacles - special: no moving left and right, only jumping! Master tasks in the new Ghost Journey event to unlock lots of cool new rewards. Buy the Season Star to get even more rewards and benefits. New clothes for the mine are also available: the mine hat, a work / tool belt and a brown color.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/09bde54f12b0f5ffc6aa6749e15f5df3c1015de6.png[/img]
[b]What happens next?[/b]
We are quite divided on what will become of The Land of Magic. We have felt the desire and fun to continue working on this game over the long development period. Questions, ideas and feedback would encourage us to continue adding new content and features to the game. We already have ideas and plans for possible further functions and content. These will be integrated into upcoming major updates if there is further interest from our players. Plans include everything from multiplayer modes to new time-limited events. Research into monsters or animals is also being planned and in some cases is already being implemented.

We would be very happy to receive feedback and your comments and suggestions in general. You can pass these on to us in various ways: [url=https://discord.gg/PusYPgz5sz]Discord-Server[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/_the_land_of_magic_/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VaCCeGGFSAt5VAsgUe44]WhatsApp[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/MagicAme_CIL]Twitter / X[/url] or our [url=https://magicame.netlify.app/support]Support[/url].
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/ddfc96273380c85aa6c7d1635940ae77d1d2bfba.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925861/fb888fc777489f136285b4828e58c30d82379b36.png[/img][/url]

Thanks to all the early players and beta testers. Thank you itch.io for this time and development. It's been an exciting and long time in development, but now it's time for a new beginning...
-Your MagicAme team!
